notes:
First Windows and Linux release of Quota (preview). The Mac app is unchanged in this release.

## Downloads

- Windows 10/11 (x64): `Quota-0.9.0-windows-x64-setup.exe`. Installs for your user only, no admin needed.
- Linux x64: `Quota-0.9.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage`
- Linux ARM64: `Quota-0.9.0-linux-aarch64.AppImage`

Linux: `chmod +x Quota-0.9.0-linux-*.AppImage`, then run it. Installed copies update themselves from this repository.

Quota reads your usage from the vendor CLIs you already have installed and signed in to (`claude`, `codex`, `agy`, `grok`). It never asks for passwords or API keys.

## What was tested

Tested on Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04 (GNOME) and Fedora 44 (KDE Plasma, Wayland), using built-in fake data:

- tray text and badge, colours, and 9 usage scenarios: all match the Mac app;
- tray menu, the panel opening from the tray, and first-run Setup;
- silent install on Windows.

Unit tests pass on Windows and Linux in CI.

## Known issues (please fix and report back)

Each item lists the symptom, how to reproduce it, and where the code lives in the `desktop/` folder of the source repo. Source: https://github.com/DavidMolina001/Quota (branch `desktop`, private; ask David for access).

1. **Real vendor data is untested on Windows and Linux.** Only fake data has been tested so far. Sign in to `claude`, `codex`, `agy` and `grok`, then open Quota.
   - Expect real percentages.
   - "Sign in" should appear only for tools that are not signed in.
   - Code: `core/src/providers.rs`, `core/src/tools.rs`.
2. **Windows: console windows might flash** when Quota runs npm-installed CLIs (`codex.cmd` and other `.cmd` shims).
   - These run through `cmd /c` with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, but no real CLIs have been tested yet.
   - Also check that CLIs installed in non-standard folders are found.
   - Code: `core/src/tools.rs` (`command`, `search_dirs`).
3. **Windows: the tray icon starts hidden** in the taskbar overflow (^). Windows 11 does this for all new apps.
   - Workaround: Settings > Personalization > Taskbar > Other system tray icons > Quota: On.
   - Possible fix: show a one-time tip after install.
4. **Windows: SmartScreen warns on install** because the installer is unsigned. Click "More info", then "Run anyway". Fix: code signing.
5. **Ubuntu (GNOME, Wayland): the panel may open at the top left** of the screen instead of under the tray icon.
   - 0.9.0 forces XWayland (`GDK_BACKEND=x11`) to fix this, but the fix has not been checked on screen.
   - Code: `app/src/main.rs` (start of `main`, panel positioning).
6. **Ubuntu: a "WebKitWebProcess crashed" report might appear** after logout or `pkill quota`.
   - 0.9.0 now quits cleanly on SIGTERM, SIGINT and SIGHUP, but this is not yet verified.
   - Code: `app/src/main.rs` (signal handler in `setup`).
7. **KDE Plasma (Wayland): the window title bar shows a generic "W" icon** instead of the Quota logo. The app id or desktop file is not matched. Code: `app/src/main.rs`, `app/tauri.conf.json`.
8. **Linux: some screens have not been tested yet.** These were never tested on Linux:
   - the History page;
   - the Tray settings page;
   - Data export and import;
   - the Setup sign-in buttons, which open a terminal: ptyxis, kgx, gnome-terminal, konsole and others (code in `app/src/platform.rs`).
9. **Self-update is untested on Windows and Linux.** 0.9.0 is the first release in this update feed (`latest-desktop.json`), so the first real check happens when 0.9.1 ships. Code: `app/src/updates.rs`.
10. **No native Windows ARM build.** The x64 installer runs under emulation on ARM PCs. There are also no .deb or .rpm packages yet.

To report a bug, include: your OS and desktop (GNOME, KDE, …), what you clicked, what you expected, what you saw, and a screenshot.
